SELECT p.product_code, p.plan_code, r.plan_name, p.vip, p.connector_required, r.daily_meeting_limit, r.agenda_limit, r.seat_limit, r.secretary_enabled, p.status, r.policy_version AS version, r.created_at AS updated_at, r.receipt_id AS policy_receipt_id, r.policy_digest FROM fbs_product_plan p INNER JOIN fbs_plan_policy_head h ON BINARY h.product_code = BINARY p.product_code AND BINARY h.plan_code = BINARY p.plan_code INNER JOIN fbs_plan_policy_revision_receipt r ON BINARY r.product_code = BINARY h.product_code AND BINARY r.plan_code = BINARY h.plan_code AND BINARY r.receipt_id = BINARY h.active_receipt_id AND r.policy_version = h.policy_version AND r.vip = p.vip AND r.connector_required = p.connector_required AND BINARY r.status = BINARY p.status WHERE BINARY p.product_code = BINARY #{productCode} AND BINARY p.plan_code = BINARY #{planCode} AND BINARY p.status = BINARY 'ACTIVE'

SELECT p.product_code, p.plan_code, r.plan_name, p.vip, p.connector_required, r.daily_meeting_limit, r.agenda_limit, r.seat_limit, r.secretary_enabled, p.status, r.policy_version AS version, r.created_at AS updated_at, r.receipt_id AS policy_receipt_id, r.policy_digest FROM fbs_product_plan p LEFT JOIN fbs_plan_policy_head h ON BINARY h.product_code = BINARY p.product_code AND BINARY h.plan_code = BINARY p.plan_code LEFT JOIN fbs_plan_policy_revision_receipt r ON BINARY r.product_code = BINARY h.product_code AND BINARY r.plan_code = BINARY h.plan_code AND BINARY r.receipt_id = BINARY h.active_receipt_id AND r.policy_version = h.policy_version AND r.vip = p.vip AND r.connector_required = p.connector_required AND BINARY r.status = BINARY p.status WHERE BINARY p.product_code = BINARY #{productCode} ORDER BY CASE p.plan_code WHEN 'BOARD_FREE' THEN 1 WHEN 'BOARD_VIP' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END LIMIT 3

mapper.sql: b.id AS binding_row_id, b.binding_id, b.enterprise_id, b.member_id, b.user_id, b.product_code, b.source_code, b.connector_code, b.issuer_uri, b.resource_uri, b.client_id, b.principal_subject_digest, b.status AS binding_status, b.verification_method, b.evidence_digest, b.verified_at, b.last_seen_at, b.valid_until AS binding_valid_until, b.revoked_at, b.version AS binding_version, b.created_at AS binding_created_at, b.updated_at AS binding_updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT , s.scope_code FROM ( SELECT candidate.* FROM fbs_connector_binding candidate INNER JOIN fbs_enterprise_member m ON m.id = candidate.member_id AND m.enterprise_id = candidate.enterprise_id AND m.user_id = candidate.user_id AND m.status = 1 AND m.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN fbs_enterprise e ON e.id = candidate.enterprise_id AND e.status = 1 AND e.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN fbs_product_entitlement entitlement ON entitlement.enterprise_id = candidate.enterprise_id AND entitlement.member_id = candidate.member_id AND entitlement.user_id = candidate.user_id AND entitlement.product_code = candidate.product_code AND CAST(entitlement.plan_code AS BINARY) = CAST('BOARD_VIP' AS BINARY) AND CAST(entitlement.status AS BINARY) = CAST('ACTIVE' AS BINARY) AND entitlement.valid_from <= NOW(3) AND (entitlement.valid_until IS NULL OR entitlement.valid_until > NOW(3)) INNER JOIN fbs_product_plan plan ON CAST(plan.product_code AS BINARY) = CAST(entitlement.product_code AS BINARY) AND CAST(plan.plan_code AS BINARY) = CAST(entitlement.plan_code AS BINARY) AND CAST(plan.product_code AS BINARY) = CAST('FBSIR_INDEPENDENT_BOARD' AS BINARY) AND CAST(plan.plan_code AS BINARY) = CAST('BOARD_VIP' AS BINARY) AND plan.vip = 1 AND plan.connector_required = 1 AND CAST(plan.status AS BINARY) = CAST('ACTIVE' AS BINARY) WHERE candidate.enterprise_id = #{tenantId} AND candidate.product_code = #{productCode} AND candidate.source_code = #{sourceCode} AND candidate.connector_code = #{connectorCode} ORDER BY candidate.id ASC LIMIT 101 ) b LEFT JOIN fbs_connector_binding_scope s ON s.binding_id = b.binding_id ORDER BY b.id ASC, s.scope_code ASC
